title: The Signal Layer: What to Build When Anything Can Be Built — Lena Hall, Akamai
talk_summary: Lena Hall argues that when AI makes implementation cheap and convergent, the differentiator moves to choosing what to build and preserving a specific 'signal' (point of view, scope limits, customer context) through delegation and AI remixing. It is a strategy/GTM talk about product positioning and trust, not about agent orchestration mechanics.

takeaways.what_they_do: They observe that tasks with free graders (compilers, test suites) get automated first and converge, so value shifts to problems that cannot self-grade; they recommend picking work where your insight is in the delta between training data and what should exist.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Anything that you can measure you can train against... A compiler is a free grader. A test suite is a free grader.
takeaways.numbers: agent benchmark scores went from low fraction to high eighties while shipping barely moved a third

takeaways.what_they_do: They require every claim to ship with its limit attached (e.g. '90% fewer pages' next to 'every silence is visible and reversible') so that when AI remixes it into a tweet the honest constraint cannot be edited out.
takeaways.evidence_quote: make sure that the limit can't be edited out... every suppressed alert is visible

takeaways.what_they_do: Before scaling a launch, they hand the README to a fresh expert and ask them to describe the product back; the gap between that description and intent is the distortion about to be broadcast.
takeaways.evidence_quote: give a readme to an SRE who has never seen your project and ask a person to describe the product back to you

takeaways.what_they_do: They diagnose that signal decays toward the average at each delegation handoff because downstream agents lack ownership, and propose a thin function whose only job is to carry original intent intact rather than adding more process layers.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a long delegation chain plus convergence machine is really a factory for automating the signal out of your own company
